C1269.title: Uber Subdomain Takeover Bypasses SSO Authentication
C1269.summary: Uber SSO system used shared cookies across subdomains for authentication. By taking over a related Amazon CloudFront subdomain, an attacker could steal shared session cookies and bypass auth.uber.com single sign-on, achieving access control or authentication bypass across Uber subdomain sites. Details such as CSRF bypass and unregistered subdomains should be supported by the full HackerOne report if retained.
